quests.title: Shrouds That Do Not Rot
quests.text: Glass-Web Jungle Spiders spin in the {name:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways} of The Skyglass Canopy at night {zone_area:front_skyglass_canopy/rootways}. Bring me two Glass Spider Silk. It does not rot, which makes it the only shroud worth registering.

quests.title: The Last Watchmen
quests.text: Last Watchmen walk the {name:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall} of Gravesalt Escarpment after dark {zone_area:front_gravesalt_escarpment/whitewall}, still keeping a post the register closed long ago. Lay five to rest, and I will finally write the date.

quests.title: Bounty: Wyrmglass Strays
quests.text: Crown Frost Strays wander the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree} of The Wyrmglass Crown at night {zone_area:front_wyrmglass_crown/scree}. Take a boat from the Shipwright across the channel and destroy eight. The register pays in coin, again an hour after you collect.
